vetSays.line: 🛡️ Manuel, Emmett, Innocent and Maya met them at the door — 4 put down. Manuel, Emmett, Maya are hurt.
🛡️ Manuel, Emmett and Ella met them at the door — 3 put down. Manuel, Emmett, Ella are hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Manuel — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Manuel chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
💬 Emmett has been asking Manuel about Cold-Blooded — what it does, what it goes with. Planning something.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Manuel, Emmett, Tom, Onni and Elif met them at the door — 5 put down. Manuel, Emmett, Tom, Onni are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Innocent just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Manuel just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Emmett just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tom just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Manuel, Emmett, Ella, Maya and Tom met them at the door — 5 put down. Manuel, Emmett, Ella, Maya, Tom are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Manuel just put down The Eulogy... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Stan and Ava met them at the door — 2 put down. Stan, Ava are hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Yuki just put down The Commercial Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Stan, Ava, Jesse and Yuki met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 barely walked away. Stan, Ava, Jesse, Yuki are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jesse just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ava just put down The Audit... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

Yuki is showing everyone Ground Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
